summary: Frontend Review Agent (Gate 8) reviewed PR #77 for NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability. Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES — 2 blocking issues, 3 medium issues. Blocking: (B1) useAutoSave.ts passes hardcoded empty data instead of reading from sceneStore — auto-save is a no-op in production, E2E tests will fail; (B2) package.json has out-of-scope breaking changes (removed immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8; major version bumps to zustand v5 and vite v6; removed scripts; renamed package). Medium: (M1) All 4 test files use inline stubs instead of importing real production modules — zero coverage of actual code; (M2) Empty catch block in persistenceService.ts silently swallows errors; (M3) ResumePrompt lacks focus trap and Escape key handling (WCAG 2.1 AA). Architecture, idb usage, atomic transactions, validation-first crash recovery, accessibility attributes, and data-testid alignment are all correct.

blocking_issues.title: useAutoSave.ts passes hardcoded empty data — auto-save is a no-op
blocking_issues.description: The interval callback passes bricks: [], hardcoded camera state, and placeholder metadata to triggerAutoSave(). No actual user work is ever saved. E2E tests T-BE-REL-001-01 and T-BE-REL-001-02 will fail.
blocking_issues.fix: Read actual bricks/camera/metadata from sceneStore inside the hook, or accept them as parameters.

blocking_issues.title: package.json has out-of-scope breaking changes
blocking_issues.description: Removed immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8; bumped zustand 4→5 and vite 5→6 (major versions); removed scripts (lint:fix, format, format:check, type-check, test:e2e:ui); renamed package from legobuilder to legobuilder-frontend.
blocking_issues.fix: Revert package.json to main branch version, only add idb (^8.0.2) to dependencies and fake-indexeddb (^6.0.0) to devDependencies.

medium_issues.title: Tests use inline stubs instead of importing production code
medium_issues.description: All 4 test files define their own implementations rather than importing the real production modules. Tests provide zero coverage of actual production code.
medium_issues.fix: Update test imports to use the real production modules.

medium_issues.title: Empty catch block silently swallows errors
ResumePrompt lacks focus trap and Escape key handling
medium_issues.fix: Track as follow-up issue for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

strengths: idb library used correctly (not raw IndexedDB) per LLD Section 13
Validation-first crash recovery with schema version check
PersistenceError class with typed error codes
All data-testid attributes match E2E selectors
beforeunload listener with cleanup on unmount
Clean module separation and JSDoc documentation
